text:
Alex: Quick run-history UX idea: show a one-line condensed row for structured/tool-call invocations that can expand inline. Want feedback on layout, copy, and a11y. Marta: sketch pls. Collapse per invocation or group by similarity? Alex: per invocation, with an optional "Condense similar runs" user toggle. Row shows prompt snippet, schema status pill, tool count icons, duration, and a small "Details" action. Sam: a11y: make the row a single focusable control (role="button") with aria-expanded, reduce extra tab stops. Announce schema status and tool count. Julia: copy nit: use "Details" not "Inspect". Replace "OK" with "Matches schema" or "Schema mismatch" for clarity. Priya: UX: show first 1-2 key/value pairs (muted) for structured outputs inline, but mask values flagged as sensitive. Add PII policy check. Marta: visual: keep summary single-line with ellipsis, tooltip on hover/focus shows full prompt. On mobile expand inline. Add a pin affordance to keep runs expanded. Alex: sample markup idea (sketch):
[prompt snippet] [Matches schema] [revenue: $X, goal: increase] [Details]
Sam: performance: lazy-load full JSON when expanding, show spinner and announce via aria-live. Consider prefetching details for visible runs (most-recent 5). Julia: add visually-hidden prefix for screen readers like "Open run details for {time}". Analytics: track run.details.open, run.details.pin, run.group.toggle. Priya: grouping: show a group header with count and chevron. Grouping should be reversible per user/channel. Marta: I'll produce comps for condensed row, grouped stack, and masked-value states by EOD tomorrow. Sam: eng will prototype aria hooks and lazy-load today, drafting a PR. DesignBot: attached mock: run-history-condensed-v2.png and set reminder for follow-up in 48h. Alex: action items: design comps (Marta), eng prototype + lazy-load (Sam), copy updates (Julia), PII policy check (Priya), analytics instrumentation (Alex). Julia: QA will prepare NVDA/VoiceOver test cases and keyboard checklist. Alex: thank you all. Reconvene after comps. :thumbsup:
